item.title: Fauci’s Pardon From Biden Would Not Shield Him From New Offenses

item.media:description: Former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. and Dr. Anthony S. Fauci during a news conference at the White House in 2021. Mr. Biden issued a pre-emptive pardon for Dr. Fauci on the last day of his term as president.

item.title: Teenage Lifeguard Fights Intense Waves to Bring Boy to Safety

item.title: Senators Cornyn and Tillis Threaten to Block Blanche Nomination Over Trump’s IRS Deal

item.title: Florida Professor Fired for Assigning a Profane Story, Lawsuit Says

item.media:description: Todd Blanche, the acting attorney general, has said the Justice Department dropped its plan for a $1.8 billion fund to pay purported victims of government weaponization, but the department can make such payouts even without a formal fund structure.
